content.value: On 1st January 2021 Mr. Mamun established the ABC travel Agency. The following transaction were completed during the month:
2021, January-1 Mr. Mamun invested cash TK 2,00,000 in the name of Agency.
99 2 Paid TK 5,000 cash for January office rent.
99 3 Purchased office equipment for TK 25,000 cash.
99 4 Incurred advertising expenses of TK 3,000 in the "Daily Ittefaq" on account.
5 Paid TK 6,000 cash for office supplies.
99 6 Earned TK 1,00,000 for service rendered: cash received TK 40,000 from customers and the balance of TK 60,000 is billed to customers on account.
99 8 Paid the “Daily Ittefaq” amount due in transaction January 4.
99 9 Withdrew cash TK 4,000 for personal use.
12 Received TK 60,000 in cash from customers who have previously been billed in transaction January 6.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2021
